title: Local spectral gap and the Stuck--Zimmer conjecture
summary: We prove two new cases of the Stuck--Zimmer conjecture. First, we settle the Stuck--Zimmer conjecture for ergodic probability preserving actions of irreducible lattices (both uniform and non-uniform) in connected semisimple real Lie groups with finite center, no compact factor and real rank at least two. We furthermore extend the Stuck--Zimmer theorem to all irreducible probability preserving actions of such groups whenever one simple factor is locally isomorphic to $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb R)$.
